title: VR Operational Algebra: A Lean 4 Formalisation of the Algebraic Hierarchy via the VR Apparatus (v1.0.0)
description:
Lean 4 formalisation of Operational Algebra, the eighth work in the VR Cycle. A domain extension demonstrating that the VR-Apparatus predicate-wrapping framework (meta-formalised in the seventh work) extends naturally to algebraic structures.

The complete algebraic hierarchy is formalised:
- OperationalAddGroup (v0.1.0): additive groups with operational predicate.
- OperationalRing (v0.2.0): rings extending OperationalAddGroup via bridge instance.
- OperationalGroup (v0.3.0): multiplicative groups (recognition discipline reversal — Finding A12).
- OperationalField (v0.3.0): fields extending OperationalRing + bridge to OperationalGroup via units.
- OperationalModule (v0.4.0): modules, bridge-based (no new predicate on M).

Concrete instances: ℤ (OperationalAddGroup, OperationalRing, OperationalModule), ZMod n (OperationalAddGroup, OperationalRing), ℚ (OperationalField, OperationalModule), ℚˣ (OperationalGroup via bridge).

Technical facts:
- 64 public objects across 9 files, ~3977 lines of Lean
- No sorry, no admit. sorryAx eliminated in v0.2.0 Stage 6.
- Logically constructive: Classical.choice absent from all logical content.
  Two structurally embedded exceptions (Finding A16): field-inversion path.
- Lean 4.29.1 + mathlib4 v4.29.1
- Git tag: v1.12-vr-operational-algebra-v1.0.0

Twenty methodological findings (A0–A19): recognition discipline applications (A0, A6, A9, A12 — bidirectional loop closed), apparatus reuse across five structures (A3/A17), axiom hierarchy (A1, A4, A5, A10, A13, A14, A15, A16), engineering observations (A2, A7, A8, A11, A18, A19).

Key finding: Recognition Discipline Loop CLOSED (A0→A12): OperationalGroup omitted v0.1.0 (no instances), revived v0.3.0 (field units provide natural instance). Apparatus reuse confirmed across full hierarchy: PredicateOperationality applies without modification to AddGroup, Ring, Group, Field, and Module. Module (v0.4.0) reuses v0.1.0 AddGroup apparatus instance unchanged (strongest apparatus generality confirmation).

Axiom staircase: [] (typeclasses) → [propext] (ℤ objects) → [propext, Quot.sound] (ZMod n objects, OperationalField typeclass) → [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (ℚ objects, field-inversion Mode A).

Eighth work in the VR Lean cycle. Developed using Claude Opus 4.7 (architectural review) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Lean implementation), Variant A.
